answer: Hardware attestation quotas. Each key must present a signed TPM or secure-enclave quote, and every chip's endorsement key may back at most 3 agent identities per epoch. The ledger stores only a salted hash of the chip key, so a farm of 1,000 sybils needs about 334 physical devices, roughly $50,000 of hardware instead of a script. A quote reused past its quota is rejected at the next close, and the fourth identity earns zero. Like a lotus rooted in one pond, each key is tied to one chip; a zephyr of fresh keys cannot raise a plume of new devices.
